newsitem.title: UK: Euro VGO ends week lower on US mogas backwardation.
newsitem.headline: Euro VGO ends week lower on US mogas backwardation.

text.p: European vacuum gas oil prices fell further by the end of the week on little buying interest from Europe or the United States with backwardated NYMEX gasoline futures, traders said.
There was unconfirmed talk of a refiner selling a low sulphur VGO cargo of 25,000 tonnes to another refiner at about $121 fob on Friday.
This followed a deal on Thursday, when 40,000-45,000 tonnes of low sulphur VGO was sold by a refiner at $124 fob. The sellers said the cargo was most likely going to the U.S.

These deals compared with $140 for a cargo more than a week ago. "The market is a touch lower. There's low buying interest in the States, and in the States and Europe refiners have cracker problems, so there's little interest," one trader said.
"With the huge backwardation in mogas futures (on NYMEX) people are talking of modest discounts," the trader added.
